name: Research Organization Registry
freeEvidence: Official API documentation permits access without registration, subject to 2000 requests per five minutes per IP. Official terms dedicate IDs and metadata to CC0 with no access/reuse restriction. One organization metadata read; count the hosted ROR product once, not each organization.

name: Reactome
freeEvidence: Official hosted Content Service documents public read-only JSON access to pathway/reaction records. Reactome annotation data are released under CC0; software, illustrations and branding have separate CC-BY conditions. One reaction metadata request, no analysis job or file download; count the product once.

name: RNAcentral
freeEvidence: Official help describes the open public resource and API, and explicitly licenses website content under CC0 for any purpose. This bounded anonymous GET retrieves one noncoding RNA sequence and annotations. Member databases, species and sequence records do not multiply the API count.

name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database
freeEvidence: Official API guide provides hosted prediction-metadata access. Official license explicitly permits academic and commercial data use under CC-BY 4.0, subject to attribution and scientific-use disclaimers. This reads one existing prediction, not a computation/inference job; model records are not separate APIs.

name: QuickGO
freeEvidence: Official QuickGO REST documentation provides public ontology/annotation reads. EMBL-EBI terms make online data services freely available and add no restrictions beyond data-owner terms; retain GO/GOA attribution and source licensing. This is one ontology term from the hosted QuickGO service; GO/ECO datasets and actions do not create additional API identities.

name: InterPro
freeEvidence: Official InterPro API documentation provides anonymous entry metadata. EMBL-EBI terms make data services freely available without extra reuse restrictions beyond original owners. Retain attribution and member-source conditions; read one classification entry, not a submitted sequence-analysis job. InterPro versions, MCP and member signatures count once.

name: Ontology Lookup Service
freeEvidence: Official OLS documentation provides public GET access, including a single ontology record. EMBL-EBI freely available services terms apply, and the chosen EFO metadata explicitly carries its source license; preserve ontology-specific notices. OLS3/OLS4 and individual hosted ontologies are one service, not multiple APIs.

name: PRIDE Archive
freeEvidence: Official REST guide documents anonymous reads of public project metadata. EMBL-EBI terms provide freely available services and no additional restrictions beyond original data owners. Preserve the project license field and source attribution; only published project metadata, not embargoed submissions or bulk spectral files. Count the archive once.

name: BioStudies
freeEvidence: Official help documents public study-info GET. New datasets are CC0; older records retain their explicit licenses, or the permissive EMBL-EBI terms when no license is stated. This reads public release/file-location metadata only; preserve study rights. ArrayExpress collections and study records do not add separate API products.

name: BioSamples
freeEvidence: Official BioSamples documentation provides public JSON sample search. EMBL-EBI terms make services freely available and impose no restrictions beyond data-owner conditions. Preserve record-specific data-use terms and attribution. This bounded published metadata search needs no login; private sample access, curation and submission are excluded.

name: MGnify
freeEvidence: Official introduction explicitly describes MGnify as free to use; current v2 REST guide documents keyless public study reads. EMBL-EBI terms preserve original data rights without additional restrictions. One public study metadata request, no submitted analysis/private access/raw sequence download; API versions and genome catalogs count once.

name: UniChem
freeEvidence: Official UniChem web-service guide documents anonymous GET source metadata. EMBL-EBI terms provide free services with no additional restrictions beyond data-owner terms. This reads one source directory record, not licensed compound records from external databases; retain notices and count UniChem once across versions and sources.

name: MetaboLights
freeEvidence: Official MetaboLights documentation describes an open-access public metabolomics repository with reusable study metadata and a REST API. EMBL-EBI terms provide free online services with no extra restrictions beyond original owners. This reads one published study metadata document; preserve study-specific licenses, attribution and raw-data rights. No private study/submission/file-transfer operation.

name: Directory of Open Access Journals
freeEvidence: Official terms explicitly dedicate journal and article metadata, including API access, to CC0. Anonymous public journal search returns one metadata result without credentials. This does not copy article full text, website design or blog content (which has separate noncommercial licensing). Count DOAJ once across journals and articles.

name: HUGO Gene Nomenclature Committee
freeEvidence: Official REST guide provides anonymous JSON gene-symbol lookup and a 10 requests/second limit. Official HGNC license makes all data freely available under CC0 and explicitly permits any form of reuse; attribution is recommended. One gene-symbol record, not each gene as a separate API.

name: Electron Microscopy Data Bank
freeEvidence: Official EMDB API documentation provides public reconstruction metadata. Official policies require entry owners to permit unrestricted distribution and state released EM data/metadata are public without restriction; the wwPDB archive is CC0. This bounded JSON read downloads no 3D map. EMDB is the separate 3DEM reconstruction archive, not another PDB endpoint or individual reconstruction.

name: BioModels
freeEvidence: Official BioModels resource description makes hosted models freely usable, modifiable and redistributable under CC0 and documents programmatic web services. The former EMBL-EBI host redirects to the current canonical www.biomodels.org service. This anonymous JSON GET reads one published curated model metadata record; no account, simulation job or upload. Count the migrated product once.
